title: NowcastNet: extreme-precipitation forecasts up to three hours ahead
summary: A model combining neural networks and physical constraints forecasts precipitation up to three hours ahead; 62 meteorologists preferred it in 71% of 2,400 evaluated events. Tsinghua reports it was already deployed on the National Meteorological Center’s operational SWAN 3.0 platform. Expert preference does not measure reduced damage or guarantee accuracy for every event.
organization: Tsinghua University / National Meteorological Center / UC Berkeley
